Ubiquiti POE-48-24W-G 48V 0.5A (24W) Gigabit PoE Adapter

The Ubiquiti POE-48-24W-G 48V 0.5A (24W) Gigabit PoE Adapter is a reliable solution for powering various network devices, such as IP cameras, wireless access points, and VoIP phones. With an output voltage of 48V DC at 0.5A, this adapter delivers a maximum power of 24W, ensuring efficient operation for your essential equipment. Designed with advanced protection features, the adapter includes surge protection for both difference and common modes, as well as clamping protection at 11V for data and 60V for power. This ensures that connected devices are safeguarded against voltage spikes, enhancing their longevity and reliability. The adapter can handle a maximum surge discharge of 1500A, providing robust defense in demanding environments. With an efficiency rating exceeding 80%, the Ubiquiti POE-48-24W-G minimizes energy waste, making it an environmentally friendly choice. The switching frequency of 65 kHz and output ripple of just 1% ensure stable and clean power delivery. Line regulation is maintained at ≤ 3%, and load regulation at ≤ 5%, allowing the adapter to perform optimally even under varying loads. Operating within a temperature range of 0 to 40°C (32 to 104°F) and a humidity range of 35% to 95% non-condensing, this adapter is versatile enough for various settings. Its compact dimensions (92 x 60 x 33 mm) and lightweight design (158.5 g) make it easy to install in tight spaces. Certified by CE, FCC, IC, and UL, the Ubiquiti POE-48-24W-G is a dependable choice for enhancing your network infrastructure. Whether you're setting up a new system or upgrading an existing one, this PoE adapter delivers efficiency, protection, and performance you can trust.

Features of the Ubiquiti POE-48-24W-G 48V 0.5A Gigabit PoE Adapter:

  • Power Output: Delivers a stable 48V DC output at 0.5A, providing up to 24W of power suitable for various network devices.
  • Surge Protection: Equipped with both difference and common mode surge protection to safeguard connected equipment from voltage spikes.
  • Clamping Protection: Features clamping protection at 11V for data lines and 60V for power, ensuring additional safety for sensitive devices.
  • High Efficiency: Achieves over 80% efficiency, minimizing energy loss and promoting environmentally friendly operation.
  • Compact Design: Compact dimensions of 92 x 60 x 33 mm (3.62 x 2.36 x 1.30 inches) and a lightweight build of 158.5 g (5.59 oz) allow for easy installation in tight spaces.
  • Wide Operating Range: Functions effectively in operating temperatures from 0 to 40°C (32 to 104°F) and storage temperatures from -30 to 70°C (-22 to 158°F).
  • Regulation Performance: Maintains line regulation of ≤ 3% and load regulation of ≤ 5%, ensuring consistent power delivery.
  • Fast Response Time: Features a response time of less than 1 nanosecond, providing rapid power adjustments.
  • Certifications: Complies with multiple safety certifications, including CE, FCC, IC, and UL, ensuring reliable and safe operation.
  • High Surge Discharge Capacity: Supports a maximum surge discharge of 1500A, providing robust protection against power surges.
  • These features make the Ubiquiti POE-48-24W-G an ideal choice for powering network devices in various settings.
